page0.text:
"Ouch... Saber never went easy on me..."
I crawl into bed.
My body is covered in bruises and pain relief patches, and I'm sure it'll all be sore tomorrow.

page1.text:
"...I'm tired."
Really, that's an understatement.
After training with Saber, I did my daily Strengthening routine, so I'm tired both mentally and physically.

page2.text:
Saber and Fuji-nee are sleeping in a room nearby, but I don't even care right now.
I'm just exhausted.
I'll sleep for now and prepare for tomorrow...

page3.text:
...Am I dreaming?
I must've dozed off.
My body's asleep and I can't even lift a finger.
Then...this has to be a dream.

page4.text:
...It's a dark night.
There's a weird ringing in my ears.
My legs are still asleep, but I'm walking down a hill.

page5.text:
It's cold.
The wind is stabbing my cheeks. I must still be in my pajamas as the rest of my body is ice cold.
...This is unusual for Fuyuki.
It feels so cold that I ought to wake from the discomfort if this were a dream.

page6.text:
I walk through the empty town.
The ringing in my ears doesn't stop.
Ignoring my shivering body, my feet are moving toward somewhere.

page7.text:
"Oh..."
I try to scream, but I notice that my throat is frozen.
This isn't a dream.
This can't be a dream.
But I still feel like I'm asleep.
My limbs... They aren't following my orders, and they are walking as if manipulated by something.

page8.text:
"Oh..."
This must be the final destination.
My feet move faster as they climb up the stone steps...
...The ringing in my ears turns into a voice.

page9.text:
"Ungh..."
No, that's wrong.
The ringing hasn't changed at all.
It has been repeating the same word over and over.
Come here.
Come on now. Come here, boy.
What fills the inside of my skull is a female voice full of magical energy.

page10.text:
I see the mountain gate.
Something's on the other side.
And...
If I cross that gate, I won't come out alive.

page11.text:
"Ungh..."
I don't know what it is, but my hazy mind screams for me to flee right now.
Go back.
Go back.
Go back.
Stop. You can still make it. Wake up right now and go back. Wake up, wake up, wake up, just don't listen to that voice...!!!
"Ungh... Oh...!"
I'm able to wake.
My hazy thoughts become clear, and my will finally returns.

page12.text:
But it's too late.
My limbs still don't obey me as they go through the mountain gate.
The only certain thing is my mind.
My body does not listen to me and walks into Ryudou Temple, not going against the voice.

page13.text:
The temple is covered in darkness.
In the center stands something with an inhuman magical energy.

page14.text:
The figure wavers like a heat haze.
A dark shadow that reminds me of a grim reaper strips off the layers of darkness and...
The figure turns into a magician that one would see in those old fairy tales.

page15.text:
"...Stop right there, boy.
I will kill you if come any closer."
She sneers.
...It seems that my body is under her control.
The feet that won't listen to me freeze at her command.

page16.text:
...
My consciousness wavers.
I can't move my own limbs at all despite an enemy appearing right before me.
...Yes, that is an enemy.
There's no doubt or hesitation.

page17.text:
That is a Servant... A Heroic Spirit who excels most in magecraft out of the seven Servants...
"...The Caster-class Servant...!"
I move my frozen throat with all my might and somehow manage to glare at my enemy.

page18.text:
"Yes, that's right, boy. Behold my temple. I welcome you, Saber's Master."
The cool voice is mocking me at the same time.

page19.text:
"Ungh...!"
I try to pour strength into my legs, but my body doesn't move at all.
Damn it, what the hell am I doing...!
I've been lured here, and on top of that, I can't move a muscle...!

page20.text:
"Ah... Guh...!"
I concentrate on my limbs with all my energy.
Whatever trick this is, Caster's magecraft is robbing the freedom to control my body.
Then if I can extract her magical energy...!

page21.text:
"You think you can free yourself? Heh, how cute. That's so precious of you to try to unravel my spell with a method like that."
"Wh...at..."

page22.text:
I concentrate everything I have to search throughout my body.
Caster's magical energy.
It's seeped into my body to take away the freedom from my limbs.

page23.text:
...I peer into my own body but keep my eyes focused straight ahead.
It's not that difficult if I stay calm.
Every night I focus on finding the magical energy and circuit within me.
I just have to repeat that and identify where Caster's poisoning me from.
Even if I can't get it out of my body, I can focus it into one of my limbs so that I can move the other three...

page24.text:
"...Huh?"
What even is this?
Caster's magical energy isn't mixed within me.
The only tainting element is this one small point on my chest.
Yet, my whole body is acting abnormally.

page25.text:
...
There's nothing wrong in my flowing blood.
But the blood vessels themselves are screwed up.
It's like my heart is locked up.
Is the red spot on my chest Caster's magical energy?
My body is completely stripped of its authority with just one word of a curse.

page26.text:
"No...way..."
So I was cursed by Caster in my sleep.
Even if I was asleep, it should be impossible for me to be captured by a magecraft that was activated so far away.

page27.text:
Mages have a resistance.
It's the power to repel magecraft effects that hypnotize, bind, or coerce.
As long as one is a mage, one cannot be easily manipulated by other mages.

page28.text:
It's a fundamental law.
Mages have Magic Circuits.
The circuits running through the body not only make magical energy, but they also have the ability to repel external magical energy.

page29.text:
It is difficult to interfere with the bodily functions of someone who has working Magic Circuits, and it is hard to control even a mage several ranks below oneself.
As the Magic Circuit repels external magical energy, the spell is destroyed before it can be completed.

page30.text:
For that reason, indirect magecraft that has those coercive or binding effects has a low success rate.
Even if the target is not a mage, the magecraft can be repelled unconsciously if they have a Magic Circuit.

page31.text:
In that regard, an intervention of just attacking with magical energy like Tohsaka does—where you make a weapon in this world and attack after completing the spell—is the most efficient magecraft.
Something that strikes physically works on other physical things.
Regardless of whether or not someone has a circuit, you bleed if you're cut.

page32.text:
...
That makes this something else entirely.
...I'm guessing if I were in close proximity, such a spell would work on me.
If I had met Caster before somewhere and had a spell cast on me then, it follows that she could affect me from some distance.

page33.text:
...But, I've never met Caster, nor do I recall having a curse cast on me.
...This is our first meeting.
Without moving from here, Caster cast a spell all the way to my house and captured my body.

page34.text:
The word "witch" pops into my head.
She can control my body from more than a few kilometers away, which shouldn't be possible if we're both mages.
But Caster can manipulate anybody in town without moving from here...

page35.text:
"Ungh..."
...My spirit weakens.
As the magecraft is complete, there's no way for me to dispel it.
I can't do anything unless Caster releases me or I get some outside help...!

page36.text:
"Do you understand now? It is my magecraft that is binding you and not my magical energy.
A completed magecraft cannot be washed away by a flow of magical energy.
It is just like a solid and liquid. The solid does not crumble even if water is poured on it, right?"
...The shadow gets closer.
The bluish purple robe melting into the night is sneering.

page37.text:
"I suppose there are exceptions.
For example...yes. The magecraft you people make is like a mud building to me.
No matter how solid it may be, I can easily wash it away with a violent current of water.
Do you understand? The difference between your kind and myself is of that magnitude."

page38.text: "Oh...really. That's why you brought me all the way here, huh?"

page39.text:
"Yes. Masters are all weaklings, but you are weakest by far.
Your resistance to magecraft is not particularly greater than a normal person here.
If I find such a Master, it is only natural that I would want to speak with them, right?"

page40.text:
She snickers.
Demonstratively, she's the superior here, and I'm just the prey.

page41.text:
"Ungh..."
...A chill runs through me.
She wants to speak to me...yeah right.
No, she's just gonna kill me...!

page42.text:
"Yet another misunderstanding, boy. Don't worry, I can't drain your magical energy if I kill you.
All the humans in this town are mine.
I wish for them to live...and grant me every single drop of their magical energy."
Her laughter echoes in my ears.

page43.text:
"Wh...at?"
I feel as though a missing piece fits inside my head.
Did she just say that she's going to drain the magical energy from everyone in this town...!?

page44.text:
"Caster...! You involved innocent people in this...!"
"Oh, you didn't know? I thought you already knew if you are cooperating with that girl... I see.
So you didn't know."
Caster's lips curl into a delighted smile.
As if she's thinking about how she will cook the prey that she caught.

page45.text:
"Then I shall tell you. I, the Servant Caster, have the right to create a territory.
Some mages have a workshop, correct? I speak of something like that.
I constructed a temple in this place to protect myself from you people.
Fortunately, this location is unfavorable for Servants.
It is excellent territory, and most of all, it is easy to gather magical energy."

page46.text:
"I couldn't hold back at first since the magical energy the lot of you have is so little, but now I can gather it most efficiently.
You can see it, right? The stockpile of hundreds of people's magical energy in this territory... Fragments from the rabble."

page47.text:
"Then... The incidents happening in this town are..."
"Yes. I told you that this is my temple, right?
Then, isn't it the duty of the people to offer me sacrifices?"

page48.text:
"Khh...!"
The unknown coma incidents happening in this town.
I didn't think it was that many, but she said hundreds of people.

page49.text:
If I look closely...
In the swirl of magical energy in this temple, it looks as if it's made up of a thousand souls.

page50.text:
"Caster...!!!"
I put strength into my limbs.
But there is no change, and Caster just stands there mocking me.

page51.text:
"Now, why don't we finish our talk.
It must be boring for you to stay there like that too."
A voice whispers in my ear.
At the same time, the enemy that I couldn't see until now fills my vision.

page52.text:
"Saber's Master. I shall take your Command Spells.
...Saber is far too valuable to have disappear.
I need her to defeat that annoying Berserker."

page53.text:
...
Caster raises her arm.
A finger inches forward toward my arm—

page54.text:
"Take...my...Command Spells...?"
Is that possible?
I think Tohsaka said that you need to pull out the nerves in order to take Command Spells...

page55.text:
"That's right. I will peel off your skin and then transplant the Command Spells to my Master.
However, the Command Spells are one with the owner's Magic Circuits, right? So removing your Command Spells also means that I will be pulling out your Magic Circuits as well."
Casually...
Caster speaks of something horrifying as if it were small talk.

page56.text:
"Wha..."
Pull out my nerves?
So she's gonna rip out the nerves in my body?
If she does that, I'll...

page57.text:
"Yes, you will not be able to retain normalcy. But don't worry, I won't take your life."
"Hnng...!"
I desperately put strength into my limbs to the point that they might get dismembered, but nothing changes.
My limbs don't move, and I'm like a prisoner about to be executed...
